pages.text: A long clothesline stretched across the yard. Steam rose from a big tub.
"Today I want to hang up the laundry." Pongi gathered the clothespins.
Dad put the laundry in the tub. A white shirt, a white towel, a white apron.
Pongi untied the red cord around her neck and put it on the table.
Dad scooped up an armful of laundry from the table and put it in the tub. The red cord went in with it.
Dad pulled out the shirt. It was pink.
The towel was pink too. So was the apron.
The red cord came out from the bottom of the tub. "Huh? Why is this in here?"
Pongi hung up the pink laundry, one piece at a time. The whole clothesline was pink.
The next day, Dad went out in a pink shirt, and Mom wore a pink apron. A pink towel lay over Dad's shoulder. Grandpa Goose stared at them for a long time.
